senses.gloss:
ऐश्वर mfn. (-रः-री-रं)
 1. Divine, relating to god, &c.
 2. Royal, supreme.
E. ईश्वर, and अण् aff.

ऐश्वर्य्य n. (-र्य्यं)
 1. Super-human power, the divine faculties of omni-
presence, omnipotence, invisibility, &c.
 2. Supremacy, dominion,
sway, power, might.
 E. ईश्वर a master, a deity, ष्यञ् aff.
